answerable.question: sg-simulation-race
answerable.answer: SimulationService.run() method initiates all requests simultaneously by creating a list of SimulatedUsers and calling the race function [S3]. Each request is handled by SimulationService.reserve(), which sends an authenticated HTTP POST request to the target service with the necessary headers and body [S2, S5]. This approach guarantees that all requests appear to be overlapping in time, simulating a real-world scenario where multiple users interact with different services concurrently.

answerable.question: sn-revocation
answerable.answer: A user's access to an open WebSocket session is closed by every collaboration server instance when a note owner's role is removed [S1]. This action is triggered in `MembersService.remove` method, which closes the WebSocket sessions of the affected user and publishes membership changes to Redis pub/sub channel for enforcement on live connections [S2, S3]. The removal event also triggers the appropriate connection phase change based on whether the session was online or offline [S7], ensuring that all collaboration servers are aware of the role change. Finally, if Redis is unavailable, the publish operation is dropped after a short timeout (1000ms) and the collaboration server falls back to its TTL-bounded permission re-check [S2].
